extension_description.message: A lightweight SEO audit tool that analyzes your webpage for key SEO factors, improving SEO, user engagement, and performance.

warning_no_data_to_display.message: No data available to display at the moment.

error_mixed_image_formats.message: Mixed modern '%s' and legacy '%s' image formats detected. It's recommended to use a consistent format for better performance and compatibility.

info_modern_image_formats.message: Modern image formats '%s' are being used, optimizing for better performance and quality.

error_legacy_image_formats.message: Legacy image formats '%s' detected. Consider using modern formats like WebP or AVIF for improved performance.

error_content_security_policy.message: Content Security Policy (CSP) is missing: Highly recommended for improving security by mitigating cross-site scripting (XSS) and other content injection attacks.

info_content_security_policy.message: Content Security Policy is a computer security concept designed to prevent cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks.

error_x_frame_options.message: X-Frame-Options: Required for improving security by preventing clickjacking attacks and blocking the embedding of content in frames or iframes.

info_x_frame_options.message: The X-Frame-Options HTTP response header indicates whether a browser is allowed to render a page in a frame or iframe. Websites can use this header to prevent clickjacking attacks by ensuring their content cannot be embedded into other sites.

error_x_xss_protection.message: X-XSS-Protection: Recommended for improving security by enabling a basic XSS filter in browsers, though more robust defenses like Content Security Policy (CSP) should also be considered.

info_x_xss_protection.message: X-XSS-Protection is an HTTP header introduced in Internet Explorer 8+. This header allows domains to enable or disable the 'XSS Filter' in IE8, which helps mitigate certain types of XSS attacks.

error_x_content_type_options.message: X-Content-Type-Options: Required for improving security by preventing MIME sniffing attacks and enforcing the declared Content-Type.

info_x_content_type_options.message: Prevents MIME-sniffing for a specific HTTP response by enforcing the declared Content-Type, reducing the risk of content-type-based attacks.

error_referrer_policy.message: Referrer-Policy: Recommended for improving privacy by controlling the amount of referrer information sent with requests.

info_referrer_policy.message: Requests made from a document and navigations away from that document include a Referrer header. This policy determines whether the browser should send the referrer or not.

error_strict_transport_security.message: Strict-Transport-Security: Required for improving security by enforcing HTTPS, preventing HTTP connections, and mitigating man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacks.

info_strict_transport_security.message: The HTTP Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header instructs the browser to enforce HTTPS and reject HTTP connections.

info_x_ua_compatible.message: Allows a website to specify how a page is rendered in Internet Explorer 8, enabling it to enforce IE7 rendering mode instead of the default IE8 rendering.

info_alt_svc.message: HTTP/3 support detected via the Alt-Svc HTTP header.

info_x_robots_tag.message: X-Robots-Tag detected in the HTTP response headers.

warning_no_rich_snippets.message: No rich snippets were found on this page. Consider adding structured data to enhance your content's appearance in search results.

warning_no_meta_tags.message: No meta tags were found on this page. Adding meta tags can improve your site's SEO and visibility in search engines.

error_empty_page_title.message: Page title is missing. Adding a clear, descriptive title helps improve SEO and enhances the page's visibility in search results.

error_short_page_title.message: Page title is too short at %s characters. Longer, descriptive titles tend to perform better in search results.

error_long_page_title.message: Page title is too long at %s characters. Search engines may truncate lengthy titles, reducing visibility and click-through rates.

error_empty_meta_description.message: Meta description is missing. A well-crafted description can significantly enhance search visibility and user engagement.

error_short_meta_description.message: Meta description is too short at %s characters. Detailed and relevant descriptions help clarify your content to users and search engines.

error_long_meta_description.message: Meta description is too long at %s characters. Overly lengthy descriptions may be truncated in search results, leading to incomplete information being displayed.

error_empty_page_language.message: Page language is not specified. Declaring a language helps search engines and accessibility tools.

error_heading_nesting.message: Found %d incorrect heading nesting(s): %s should not be followed by H%d.

error_heading_h1_order.message: Found %d heading(s) %s that should follow an H1. Check the heading order.

error_heading_h1_missing.message: Found %d heading(s) %s, that should follow an H1, but H1 is missing.

error_heading_empty.message: Found %d empty heading(s): Empty headings hurt SEO by reducing content clarity and accessibility.

error_missing_canonical_tag.message: Missing canonical tag: This can cause duplicate content issues and negatively impact SEO.

error_robots_txt_missing.message: The robots.txt file was not found, preventing search engines from receiving directives, which can negatively impact SEO.

error_blocked_robotstxt.message: The page %s is blocked by a robots meta tag, preventing search engines from indexing it. This can adversely affect SEO.

help_checkbox_fetch_robotstxt.message: Disabling the fetching of robots.txt will prevent notifications about found sitemaps and skip checking whether internal links are blocked by robots.txt rules.

text_select_ua.message: Select a User Agent from the list

txt_headings_desc.message: Properly structured headings help with content organization and improve SEO by signaling the importance of content to search engines. Missing or poorly structured headings can negatively impact accessibility and search ranking.

txt_images_desc.message: Optimizing images, including using alt text, improves accessibility and SEO. Missing alt text or large image sizes can lead to poor search engine visibility and slow page loading.

txt_links_desc.message: Internal links enhance site navigation and distribute link equity, while external links increase site authority. Broken or excessive links can hinder user experience and SEO performance.

txt_rich_snippets_desc.message: Rich snippets improve visibility in search results by displaying extra information like ratings, prices, or availability. Missing structured data or errors in implementation can lead to missed opportunities for enhanced search result presentation.

txt_meta_desc.message: Meta tags, such as titles and descriptions, play a crucial role in search ranking and click-through rates. Missing or duplicate meta tags can hurt search engine visibility and confuse users.

txt_update_error.message: Unable to load page tab information. Please refresh the tab. If the issue persists, click the 'Report Error' button below.
